decision_cutoff.semantics: Snapshot immediately before delivery starts; information must be available strictly before the anchor.
decision_cutoff.reason: The source says fixed 1h/5h forecasts are released before delivery and may be updated until one minute before delivery; the stored data do not retain exact update versions. The delivery-start anchor is the earliest cutoff supported without fabricating a historical minute-level vintage.

timestamp_mapping.dst_rule: Retain both UTC-distinct repeated local hours and record local_hour_occurrence.
timestamp_mapping.request_boundaries: Local dates, start inclusive and end exclusive.

field_availability.rule: Use only non-null same-hour fixed-horizon values; no minute-level or tick-vintage claim.
Timestamp fields describe ForecastCurrent, not the fixed 5h/1h snapshots.
Day-ahead market outcome is fixed before the delivery-hour cutoff.
Never enter the decision-time feature set.
Released and revised after delivery; retain only for mechanism analysis.
Timing passes at the delivery-start cutoff; border-specific signs and legacy nulls remain gated to P6.1.
